purpose: Keep profile/avatar/chip grouping continuous across pull-up states; correct fully expanded handle direction.

repairs.prompt:

Keep ALL visual styling, colors, paper arch, envelope pocket geometry, home background, scrim, glass navigation, typeface, Korean copy and screen dimensions of image 1. Change ONLY the internal identity group on the lifted white letter, to match the group in image 2:
1. Remove the large centered "나의 관심사" title sitting above the avatar and remove the centered standalone avatar arrangement.
2. Put the circle avatar "상" to the LEFT of the title "나의 관심사" on ONE HORIZONTAL ROW centered on the letter, exactly as the home reference. Use the same compact avatar size and same title weight as image 2. Below this row, keep chips "독서", "산책", "음악" in ONE centered row, same sequence/relative spacing as image 2. All three chips are the same neutral warm beige as home, no one chip highlighted orange.
3. Place "내가 좋아하는 이야기로 나를 소개해요" as a small helper line AFTER the chips. Below that retain the "관심사 편집" button and "더 올리거나 눌러서 편집해요". Everything fits above the anchored envelope front without overlap.
Keep the existing upward chevron handle and hint at the top. The shape and content group must look like the EXACT SAME letter lifted vertically out of the home envelope. No other changes; no new cards, no new widgets. Preserve legible Korean. Output the single updated portrait screen only.

- Toolbar stays "취소" left and "저장" right, remove the centered "나의 관심사" from this toolbar to avoid duplicate headings.

- Beneath headline reproduce the HOME group: small circular avatar "상" LEFT of title "나의 관심사" on ONE centered horizontal row. No bright glass bottom navigation in this focused editor. No other changes. Render accurate Korean without clipping. Output one updated portrait screen.
